description: Indicateurs de qualité de service (SNCF et RATP) is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Ce jeu de données est le résultat trimestriel des indicateurs de qualité de service du parcours voyageurs pour les contrats RATP (Train, Métro, Tramway et Bus: Paris, Bus en site propre, Petite Couronne, Noctilien) et SNCF (Train, Tram-Train et Noctilien). Documentation Une documentation relative aux indicateurs de qualité de service est disponible. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Fréquentation & Statistiques. Its keywords are RATP, SNCF, Chercheur ou journaliste. The portal shows 2025-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL Version Française (https://doc.transport.data.gouv.fr/le-point-d-acces-national/cadre-juridique/conditions-dutilisation-des-donnees/licence-odbl). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
